groups.label: An Ork unit with the Battle Smith (X) special rule may purchase the following Rites:
groups.printed: An Ork unit with the Battle Smith (X) special rule may purchase the following Rites:

choices.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3" of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon. The target unit may select 1 weapon it is equipped with and make a second Shooting Attack with it this Phase.

choices.name: I Can Fix That!
choices.text:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:

- Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3" or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
- Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
- Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

choices.name: Smog It!
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3" of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon. The target unit gains the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Turbo Charge!
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, the unit performing this Rite, a Vehicle, Titan, Knight, Aircraft, or Walker unit within 3" of the unit performing this Rite or a unit that unit performing unit is embarked upon may immediately make a 6.1 - Normal Move. However, the selected unit and any embarked unit may not Shoot in the Shooting Phase or Charge in the Charge Phase.
